description: The 400% cliff compares household income to 4 × the poverty line itself (§ 36B(c)(1)(A): 'does not exceed 400 percent'; Form 8962 Worksheet 2). TY2027 single, poverty line $15,960 → $63,840. Household income $63,841 is over it → no credit (the floored percentage read it as 400.00% and allowed $5,475.55).
